description: src/holon_coherence/commands/agents.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/start.py still parse HOLON_PROXY_PORT, HOLON_LOCAL_LLM_BASE, and HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB directly via os.getenv instead of reading from CoherenceSettings.from_env().
goal: Migrate direct os.getenv reads for HOLON_PROXY_PORT, HOLON_LOCAL_LLM_BASE, and HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB in src/holon_coherence/commands/agents.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/start.py to route through CoherenceSettings.from_env() (using existing proxy_port, local_llm_base, and web_inspector fields on CoherenceSettings without modifying src/holon_coherence/settings.py). Keep HOST_LOCAL_ENV_VAR handling in commands/start.py unchanged (deferred to a follow-up slice once settings.py PR merges). Keep both modules strictly within their existing line budgets (agents.py <= 454 lines, start.py <= 437 lines), create zero new Python files, and never modify src/holon_coherence/settings.py or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Add/update unit tests in tests/commands/test_agents.py, tests/commands/test_start.py, and tests/commands/test_start_web.py verifying CoherenceSettings-backed env resolution and invalid-port fallback. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Replacing duplicated port/bool/URL env parsing in commands/agents.py and commands/start.py with existing CoherenceSettings.from_env() removes drift cleanly without overlapping open PRs.
acceptance_criteria: HOLON_PROXY_PORT, HOLON_LOCAL_LLM_BASE, and HOLON_COHERENCE_WEB env reads in src/holon_coherence/commands/agents.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/start.py route through CoherenceSettings.from_env() without modifying src/holon_coherence/settings.py, verified by tests in tests/commands/test_agents.py, tests/commands/test_start.py, and tests/commands/test_start_web.py.
`uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass with zero docstrings or comments and untouched `module_budgets.json`.
